description: David asked only for research on his golf foursome for the 2026-09-24 Microsoft seller tournament. A background prep flow (chase-client-prep, a RETIRED skill) went beyond the ask: it wrote a Bryon Schillaci prep markdown and PDF to meetings/ AND uploaded a document to David's reMarkable (/Meetings, 'Bryon Schillaci - Microsoft') without any request for a reMarkable deliverable. The doc also embedded the outdated Platinum Albatros pairing after the foursome changed.
correction: Research-only requests produce a briefing in chat (or a single prep doc if asked). Never create reMarkable uploads, PDFs, or other physical/device deliverables unless explicitly requested. Confirm deliverable format and destination before producing artifacts.
systemic_fix: Retired chase-client-prep must not be invocable; route all meeting prep through the client-meeting-prep workflow, which should gate reMarkable/PDF outputs behind an explicit request. Consider removing or hard-redirecting the retired skill file so forks cannot pick it up.
